visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of photo cards with the linked title and subtitle overlaid on a dark gradient at the bottom of the image; the whole card is clickable
visualCharacteristics.description: Intro (H2, paragraph, outlined pill button) occupies first grid cell; five location cards fill a 3-column grid, each a photo with bottom dark gradient and white serif title with chevron plus subtitle overlaid.

contentPattern.structure: Image | Linked H3 title, subtitle; then Image | Linked H3 title, subtitle
contentPattern.description: Repeating look-alike items that each link to a detail page and wrap in a grid. No existing cards variants in blocks/; Photo cards with dark gradient and title/subtitle overlaid at bottom
contentPattern.blockContent: Five location cards: image, linked H3 title (e.g. 'Mayo Clinic in Arizona'), location subtitle

usage: Grid of photo cards with the linked title and subtitle overlaid on a dark gradient at the bottom of the image; the whole card is clickable.
reuseGuidance: Use for linked location/destination cards. One row per card: image cell, then body cell with a linked heading (H3) and a short subtitle. Put any intro heading/CTA as default content before the block.
